propositions: Epic close gate must block on open/in_progress bugs with caused_by edges pointing to the epic or its descendants (DET floor).
Candidate filter identifies open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition or linked to the epic subtree (any relation, any depth), capped at 32 with overflow tallying.

Haiku relevance screen performs forced-choice classification (A: defect in deliverable, B: pre-existing/adjacent, C: unrelated) with compact A-verdicts forwarded as evidence (max 8 full rows) to the verifier.
Verifier blocks only deliverable-defects with no recorded disposition: supersedes/duplicates links or reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose qualify; bare 'out of scope' does not.
Screen rides model-class config and shared cache settings with warm-then-fan-out orchestration; per-candidate failures degrade to C and do not block close.
Screen output schema registered as epic_bug_screen_verdict with normalizing validator (default: C); screen tally recorded in completion sidecar for audit and calibration.
